definitions.boundary: the position between two adjacent folds; rows before it are every row of the earlier folds, rows after it every row of the later folds
definitions.elapsed_seconds: Time as published: seconds from the first transaction in the file; not a calendar date or a time of day
definitions.exact_duplicate_group: rows equal in every column, Class included; every row of a group is kept
definitions.folds: ml.splits.chronological_split of the rows in load order (Time, then position in the file): 70/15/15 by row count, the folds a run trained on these rows records in run.json
definitions.label_conflict_group: rows equal in every column but Class that carry both labels
definitions.repeated_rows: rows of exact-duplicate groups beyond the first row of each group
definitions.rows_sharing_a_time: rows whose Time equals at least one other row's
definitions.shared_instant: the earlier fold's last Time equals the later fold's first, so rows at that Time fall on both sides of the boundary; recorded, not corrected
definitions.stops: the Phase 5E decision 15 conditions these rows trigger; any one stops the work before a model is trained
definitions.straddling_duplicate_pair: two rows of one exact-duplicate group, one before the boundary and one after it

field_notes.detail: Transaction.created_at position: 1970-01-01T00:00:00+00:00 plus Time seconds; orders and splits rows; elapsed time only, never a calendar date or a time of day; not a feature
Transaction.amount, as published and untransformed; currency not stated, none assumed
the label, 0 or 1, held apart from the values
no canonical field: PCA components of undisclosed inputs, carried as published into ULB-only features
Transaction.id: the 1-based position in the source file, stable because the digest is pinned; not a source identifier
no card or account key: no history, velocity or customer features
no merchant name, category, MCC, risk rating or country
